steps.en: Build the Maven project from source and put its jar on your classpath (no recent release)
steps.zh: 从 Maven 源码自行构建，把 jar 放进 classpath（无近期发布）

steps.en: Fetch the page yourself and pick a named extractor for it
steps.zh: 自己把网页下载好，挑一个命名提取器

steps.en: Parses the HTML with its bundled NekoHTML into a sequence of text blocks
steps.zh: 用自带的 NekoHTML 解析 HTML，切成一串文本块

steps.en: Scores each block on shallow features like word count and link density; drops boilerplate
steps.zh: 按词数、链接密度等浅层特征给每块打分，丢掉样板块

steps.en: Returns the blocks it kept as plain text
steps.zh: 把留下的文本块拼成纯文本返回

value.en: The article body without menus, footers and link lists, inside a JVM process with no external service
value.zh: 拿到去掉菜单、页脚、链接列表的正文，全在 JVM 进程里完成，不用外部服务

sources: https://github.com/kohlschutter/boilerpipe#readme (work-in-progress transmit from Google Code; Maven multi-module pom.xml, version 2.0-SNAPSHOT)

https://github.com/kohlschutter/boilerpipe/blob/master/boilerpipe-demo/src/main/java/com/kohlschutter/boilerpipe/demo/Oneliner.java (ArticleExtractor.INSTANCE.getText(url); DefaultExtractor; CommonExtractors.CANOLA_EXTRACTOR; advice to download with a fault-tolerant crawler first)
Kohlschütter et al., Boilerplate Detection using Shallow Text Features (WSDM 2010) — shallow text features such as word count and link density, cited on the page
